description: This file defines the ListViewSearchService class, which provides methods to retrieve and translate search definitions for list views in the SuiteCRM application. It interacts with various helper classes and includes functions to process search metadata, translations, and generate API responses.

classes.name: ListViewSearchService
classes.description: Provides API services for retrieving list view search definitions with translation support in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDataTranslated
methods.description: Translates search definition labels using the provided language helper and display columns.

methods.name: getListViewSearchDefs
methods.description: Retrieves, processes, translates search definitions for a specific module, and returns them wrapped in a JSON serializable response.
